clarity.notes: The current conclusion, independent decision axes, strongest support, strongest contradiction, evidence rows, and exact proof form one task flow.

hierarchy.notes: Ledger and source inspector dominate Review; Claims, Verify, and Trace use projections fitted to their questions.

typography.notes: The restrained sans and mono system keeps verdict language distinct from exact evidence identity.

motion.notes: Motion is limited to review state changes and respects reduced motion.

brand.notes: Disciplined rules, negative space, and evidence alignment establish a coherent forensic case-ledger identity.

remaining_gaps: Production graph routing, data scale, and persistence are intentionally absent.
Owner live review must validate the mobile projection switch and measured task efficiency.
